Subject: POC trial kickoff — Redwood Inference + Acme Retail

Hi Carlos/Sofia,

Thanks again for taking the time today — good to meet both of you. Quick recap from our discovery and proposed next steps so we have alignment:  

- Goal: Validate Redwood’s inference runtime on Acme’s customer support reranking workload (target: 60% latency reduction, keep quality within 1% of baseline).
- Scope for trial: 2 models (reranker + lightweight generator), test dataset ~25k queries, 2-week trial window starting when sandbox is provisioned.
- Success criteria: throughput 200 qps sustained, P95 latency under 120ms, and no more than 1.5% drop in NDCG on the reranker.

Next steps I committed to:  
1) Share the POC SOW + onboarding checklist (attached).
2) Provision sandbox + API key (I’ll request infra access once you confirm the team list).
3) Schedule a 60-minute enablement session (Monica will run the session and cover model mappings and the dashboard).
4) Provide a short test prompt set and ingestion template by EOD Friday.

Requested from Acme: point person for infra (who we need to add to the sandbox), and confirmation of any firewall/IP allowlist requirements.

Attachments: POC_SOW_v1.pdf, redwood-trial-onboarding-checklist.xlsx

Can you confirm those two items and whether we should target next Tuesday (Mar 2) for the enablement session? If timeline needs to shift, happy to adapt.

Best,
Aisha
